# Search for the "Dental check-up" event
events = search_calendar_events(query="Dental check-up", date=None)

# Check if any events were found
if not events:
    raise ValueError("No Dental check-up event found.")

# Assuming there is only one such event, or taking the first one
event = events[0]

# Extract current event details
event_id = event.id_
start_time = event.start_time
end_time = event.end_time

# Calculate the duration of the original event
duration = end_time - start_time

# Define the new start time provided by the user
new_start_time_str = "2024-05-20 10:00"
new_start_time = datetime.fromisoformat(new_start_time_str)

# Calculate the new end time based on the original duration
new_end_time = new_start_time + duration
new_end_time_str = new_end_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

# Reschedule the event
rescheduled_event = reschedule_calendar_event(
    event_id=event_id,
    new_start_time=new_start_time_str,
    new_end_time=new_end_time_str
)

print(f"Event rescheduled successfully to {new_start_time_str}.")
